notes.title: Dev Log - September 2025
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]
Later than I wanted to do, the September Dev Log.
To be honest, I forgot to post it after coming back from vacation. Sorry for that and for being late now.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the reasons why I forgot is that I almost instantly went back to development after coming back.
The good thing is, the October Dev Log will be here on time, so it's just half a month until the next news. Yay... I guess?![/p][p]Anyway... the vacation was great and I had the chance to disconnect a little from all the daily routine stuff and recharge my batteries.
As usual, the mind still wanders back to the story from time to time, and I still wrote down some dialogue and notes during vacation.
One of the first things I did when coming back was take those notes and ideas into my scripts and game notes so I don't forget about them.[/p][p]After that, I got back into my usual schedule of setting up static renders and creating the script for Chapter 7.
I also created the new internal test build last week and ran a few tests.[/p][p]
The plan for this week is to complete the scene I'm currently working on and then move on to one of the two remaining scenes before the chapter-ending scene.
More on that in the next Dev Log.

Chapter 7 currently consists of 1008 static renders and 8 animations (most of the planned animations are at the chapter ending).[/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice time, guys.
Cheers,
Ceo[/p][p]

notes.title: Dev Log - August 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]
A few days later than usual, but the Dev Log for August is finally here.[/p][p]The progress is going as planned... mostly. Mostly, because I already did a few animations that weren't planned, but I came up with an idea for them when coding the scene and went with it.
That's my usual approach, though. If I come up with something throughout development, I add (or change) it. Of course, only as long as the result is worth the time invested (in my opinion...).
If I add every idea I come up with, I'd never finish anything...

I also did a 2nd session of Q&A in July, which you can find on my [url="https://discord.gg/qqDdsn6r23"]Discord[/url] server (it's too long to add it to this Dev log).[/p][p][/p][p]As of now (August, 8th), Chapter 7 consists 715 static renders, 8 animations, and is roughly at 50% of the length of Chapter 3 (30% of Chapter 6 but it's also planned to be smaller in general).[/p][p][/p][p]September Dev Log will also be a fews days later than usual because I'll be on vacation with the family.[/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice time, guys.
Cheers,
Ceo[/p][p]

notes.title: Dev Log - July 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, 

this is the first Dev Log for Chapter 7.
Development of the new chapter started in early June after the Steam release of Chapter 6.
As usual, the start of the development cycle contains a lot of planning, like which scenes to include, when, and so on.
After that was done, I started working on the first scenes (you can see a few preview renders of them below).
The plan is that Chapter 7 doesn't take as long as Chapter 6 to develop, but also to be smaller.
And to have it ready before the end of the year.

Mind you, that's the current plan. Since I'm doing this all alone, there's still the risk of development going slower due to life (as happened earlier this year).

As of now, Chapter 7 contains 355 static renders and 1609 lines in the script file.
No animations yet as most of them are planned for the 2nd half/end of the Chapter and there will be fewer in general compared to Chapter 6.

Cheers, 
Ceo  [/p][p]

notes.title: Chapter 6 release
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I released the Chapter 6 update a few minutes ago.
Your Steam client should update automatically (you might need to restart it before).

Chapter 6, called "Crossroads", is the biggest Chapter to date, although that heavily depends on your choices before.
The main focus of this Chapter is the personal stories of Kaija, Fiona, and Elea since they had barely any screentime in Chapter 5. So if you ignore those 3, Chapter 6 can feel very short.

The final numbers for Chapter 6:
2735 new static renders
113 new animations
7831 lines in the script file

Due to some events beyond my control, the development time of this Chapter took a bit longer than I expected.
I hope (and plan for) that Chapter 7 will take less time than Chapter 6.
More on that in future Dev Updates.

Have a nice weekend.

Cheers,
Ceo

notes.title: Chapter 6 Beta and Release Date
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The thing most of you're looking for first:
The release date of Chapter 6 on Steam is set to [b]May 30th, 2025[/b].

I just sent out the beta build to my testers.
It contains all the content for Chapter 6 and is only missing a few images for the Gallery and one animation for the ending of the Chapter.
I'll work on these while my testers will... well... test.
Additionally, I still need to set up the Steam achievements, which is quite a bit of work, too.

Overall, I don't expect game-breaking stuff to pop up during the Beta, and I'm pretty positive about the release date.

Cheers,
Ceo

notes.title: Dev Log - May 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'll keep this one short because I want to use the time to get the new update done.
The progress has been pretty good in the past month, and right now

Once that is done, I'll set up the Beta build, which the beta testers will then test.
When the build is ready and delivered, I'll announce the release date of the Steam update (probably ~4 weeks after Beta).

So you can expect another Event post from me this month.

Cheers,

notes.title: Dev Log - April 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

April is already here, and sadly, the development of Chapter 6 is still in progress.
I'm getting closer to finishing Chapter 6, but to be honest, I hoped to be at least in Beta by now.
The events of February and March didn't help, of course.
The good news is that I'm kinda back on track and hopefully can wrap up Chapter 6 quickly.

I created my last test build this week, which will be the last build before Beta and contains roughly 90% of the planned content.
To put it into numbers, that means 2240 static renders, 96 animations, and the script file has almost reached the size of Chapter 5 (~6400 lines vs ~6800).

I hope to get all remaining work done in April so I can move into Beta at the end of the month.
At least, that's the plan for now.
With a bit of luck, the next announcement here will be the Beta state.


Cheers,
Ceo

notes.title: Dev Log - March 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

February was a shit month in several ways.
First, I caught the flu, which knocked me out for more than a week, and then we had a very critical health issue in the closest family circle. Sadly, the last one is still ongoing.
In short, progression wasn't as good as I wanted it to be and what I'm used to.
It sucks even more because I have roughly 4-5 weeks of work remaining and wanted to get that done until end of March. Right now, it looks more like April... if life spares me with more crap. 

I'm sorry, that I don't have better news, but sometimes life just keeps throwing wrenches at you.
Be assured, that every free minute I have goes into finishing that damn Chapter.

As of now, Chapter 6 contains 1988 static renders and 54 animations.

As usual, I'll attach a few preview renders done in the past month.

Cheers,
Ceo

notes.title: Dev Log - February 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's time for the February Dev Log.

I finally finished Kaija's scene, which is the longest of the Chapter (and one of the longest of the whole game), and moved on to the next scenes.
The work on those went pretty well and I was able to move on to the next longer schene (Fiona) before the end of January.
So now I'm working on Fiona's scene for Chapter 6 which will keep me busy for a while too.
It's not as long as Kaija's scene but still pretty big.
I plan to finish that scene mid to end of February and after that, it's Elea's scene (also a longer scene) and the Chapter finale (shorter than the previous Chapter endings).

As of now, Chapter 6 contains 1775 static renders, 47 animations, and is script-wise between the length of Chapters 4 and 5.

Last but not least, in preparation for the Steam Visual Novel Fest in March, we set up a new bundle which you can find here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49327/Beyond_Boundaries_The_FourWorld_Adventure/]Beyond Boundaries - The FourWorld Adventure[/url]

As usual, I'll attach a few preview renders done in the past month.

Have a good start to your week, guys.

Cheers,
Ceo

notes.title: Dev Log - January 2025
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone.

I failed to post my next Dev Log before the end of the year, sorry for that.
December was pretty busy with all the holiday stuff going on and I put every available minute into developing the next chapter.
But I'm now (finally...) back to my normal working schedule.

Both PCs were pretty much rendering all through the holidays which kept my office nice and warm at sub-tropical temperatures (read: way too warm!).
They're still busy rendering the remaining images and animations for the scene I was working on but once they're done I can build my next internal test build and then finally move on to the next scenes.

I have a post-winter sale running for those who missed the platform sale due to being busy with their family (how dare you?). :-)

The current version of Chapter 6 contains 1316 renders and 42 animations.

Have a good start to the new year.

Cheers,
Ceo

notes.title: Dev Log - December 2024
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

December is here and that means another month passed by.
The work with 2 PCs is still a bit tricky for me and as a result I'm looking into options to make it easier.
The main focus is on getting and setting up a NAS that provides the files for rendering to both PCs so I don't have to copy them by hand.
Other than that, the 2nd PC proved to be useful for rendering the animations and I was able to continue the work on the main PC.

In general, it made working on the game a lot easier because it means less planning and organizing when to pose, when to render, and so on.
Everything that will take longer to render, gets passed over to the 2nd PC and can be rendered there.

As of now, Chapter 6 contains already 980 static renders and 14 animations.

December is usually a very busy time with family stuff but I'll try to squeeze in as much time as possible for the work on the game.
I'll try to come up with a new Dev Log before the end of the year.
Until then, have a good time and a Merry Christmas.

Cheers,
Ceo

notes.title: Dev Log - November 2024
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Time for the November development update.
Despite having a few health issues (I caught a cold that's still bugging me a little bit) in the past several days, the progress on Chapter 6 is still acceptable (to me at least).

Until now I got 638 static renders and 4 new animations for Chapter 6 done.
The scene I'm currently working on is one of the longest in Chapter 6 so it will keep me busy the next several days. It will also raise the animation count significantly.

That will also be the first time where I can work with both PCs having one for setting up renders/animations and the other one to render them.
While my available time is usually the limiting factor on progress, when it comes to animations it's usually render speed because rendering them tends to block the PC for several days.

With the money from the Steam release, I was able to set up a second PC so I don't have to decide between rendering and posing new renders.
I'll see how that turns out later this month.

To wrap up this Dev Log, I'll attach a few preview renders from the current development.

Cheers,
Ceo

notes.title: Dev Log - October 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been 4 weeks since the release of The Neverwhere Tales - Book 1 and I want to use this chance to thank everyone who bought it for their support.
I'll try to keep track of questions and discussions in the Steam forums but since that is all new to me I still need to establish a workflow to check the discussions.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to post them in the discussions.
I'll try to answer everything as long as it's not going into spoiler territory.

I want to post Dev Logs here regularly but haven't decided on the interval or a format.
For now, I'll start with monthly and see how that works out.

The work on Chapter 6 started in early September, so this is the progress of roughly 1 month of development.
As of now, there are 332 new renders done, 2 new animations, and 1106 lines in the script file.
To give you some context, Chapter 5 had ~2400 renders, 59 animations, and 6803 lines.
That doesn't necessarily mean Chapter 6 will be as big as Chapter 5 but it should give you a rough idea.

Below you'll find a few preview renders from Chapter 6.

Have a nice weekend.
